sbar.situation: Dispatch has recovered. The last two recovery checks, ending at 24 s, ran the main journey cleanly with healthy metrics on every component.
sbar.background: An operator changed the unit-sync setting batch_size from 200 to 0, which paused all unit status processing. About three seconds later, call-handling was deployed from version 5.2 to 5.3, and 7% of calls began to be refused against a normal 0%.
sbar.assessment: The batch_size of 0 stalled unit-sync with 304 items in the backlog and none being processed. This failed the journey and let CAD unit timers expire (confidence 0.95). The call-handling 5.3 release is the likely cause of the refused calls (confidence 0.7). The incident commander itself restored batch_size to 200 and rolled call-handling back from 5.3 to 5.2, and both actions completed.
sbar.recommendation: Confirm that the 304-item unit-sync backlog has drained and that CAD unit statuses are correct. Have operations review the calls refused and the unit timers that expired during the incident. Keep call-handling on 5.2 until the 5.3 release has been investigated, and find out why the operator set batch_size to 0.
